title: Embedded Controls Architecture
short_summary: Technical definition of embedded control functions for vehicle, powertrain, and physical systems.
long_summary: Defines boundaries between control intent, software architecture, diagnostics, calibration hooks, and integration interfaces so algorithms can survive real ECU timing, signal quality, physical constraints, and validation requirements.

title: Control Systems & Estimation
short_summary: Real-time control, virtual sensing, observer design, calibration, model adaptation, and system identification for physical systems.
long_summary: Connects physical behavior, models, measurements, and software implementation through feedback control, virtual sensing, observer design, calibration, model adaptation, stochastic detection, and system identification.

title: Embedded Software & Validation
short_summary: Production delivery of embedded control software from implementation to validated release.
long_summary: Turns control concepts and software architecture into testable embedded software, integrating generated code, C/C++ implementation, calibration workflows, validation evidence, and release-oriented delivery practices.

title: Diagnostics, Safety & Robustness
short_summary: Diagnostic and safety-aware control software for reliable physical systems.
long_summary: Separates physical cause, signal symptom, control response, and degraded behavior, then uses evidence to decide what the system can still do safely and reliably.

title: Electric & Autonomous Vehicle Systems
short_summary: Embedded control software for electric, autonomous, and heavy-duty vehicle platforms.
long_summary: Coordinates energy, actuation, sensing, and protection logic so vehicle behavior remains predictable across charging, propulsion, thermal limits, and degraded operating conditions.

title: Technical Leadership
short_summary: Technical direction for embedded software teams in automotive development environments.
long_summary: Makes ambiguous engineering work visible: what is known, what is assumed, what must be validated, and which choices affect delivery, quality, and long-term maintainability.
